📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • Pull out the LARGEST perfect square (perfect cube for 3 ​): 72​=62​.提出最大的完全平方因数（立方根提完全立方数）：72​=62​。
  • Mixed → entire: square the outside number and multiply it in: 35​=45​.最简根式化为整根式：把外面的数平方后乘进去：35​=45​。
  • To compare radicals, rewrite all as entire radicals and compare the insides.比较根式大小：都化成整根式，比较根号里面的数。

💡 Which is bigger, 35​ or 211​? Without a calculator it looks like a guess — move the outside numbers inside the root and the answer is obvious.35​ 和 211​ 哪个大？不用计算器像在猜——把根号外的数挪进根号里，一眼就看出来。

  1. Mixed radical → simplest form: pull out the LARGEST perfect-square factor. 72​=36⋅2​=62​. For cube roots, pull out perfect cubes: 354​=327⋅2​=332​.化成最简根式：提出最大的完全平方因数。72​=36⋅2​=62​。立方根就提完全立方因数：354​=327⋅2​=332​。
  2. Mixed → entire: square the outside number and multiply it in. 35​=9⋅5​=45​. For index n, raise it to the nth power.最简根式 → 整根式：把根号外的数平方后乘进去。35​=9⋅5​=45​。根指数为 n 时就乘 n 次方。
  3. To order radicals, write them all as entire radicals with the same index and compare what is inside.比较根式大小：全部化成同一根指数的整根式，比较根号里的数。
  4. With variables, an even index needs a non-negative radicand: 18x3​=3x2x​ only makes sense for x≥0. State the restriction.含字母时，偶次根号里必须非负：18x3​=3x2x​ 只在 x≥0 时有意义，要写出限制条件。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

ab​=a​b​(a,b≥0)
Product rule for radicals根式乘法法则
kna​=nkna​
Mixed ↔ entire radical最简根式与整根式互化
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Ordering and "simplify fully" questions are almost always non-calculator. Convert everything to entire radicals for ordering, and always ask "can the leftover radicand still be divided by 4, 9, 16 or 25?" before you stop.比较大小和「完全化简」题几乎都不许用计算器。比较时全部化成整根式；化简完再问一句：「剩下的根号内还能被 4、9、16、25 整除吗？」

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Read the index (2 or 3) and the radicand. With letters, note which exponents are odd and whether you are told x≥0.读出根指数（2 还是 3）和被开方数。有字母时，看哪些指数是奇数，题目有没有说 x≥0。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Simplest form: no perfect-square factor left inside (perfect cube for 3 ​), plus a restriction if an even root holds a letter. For ordering: a list from least to greatest.最简形式：根号里不再有完全平方因数（立方根就是完全立方因数）；偶次根号里有字母时还要写限制条件。排大小时：从小到大的一串。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    A factor tree of the radicand. Circle each PAIR of equal primes (each triple for a cube root); every circled group comes out as one number.给被开方数画因数树。把相同质数「两个一圈」（立方根就三个一圈）；每圈出一组，就有一个数出到根号外。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Try the perfect squares from big to small (100, 81, 64, 49, 36, 25, 16, 9, 4) until one divides the radicand; split and take its root out. To compare, square the outside number and move it in.从大到小试完全平方数（100、81、64、49、36、25、16、9、4），直到有一个能整除被开方数；拆开，把它的平方根提出去。比较大小时，把外面的数平方后乘进去。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Multiply back: (outside)2× inside must give the original radicand. Then ask: can the leftover still be divided by 4, 9 or 25?乘回去：（外面的数）2× 里面的数必须等于原来的被开方数。再问：剩下的还能被 4、9 或 25 整除吗？

1Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根
Which number is a perfect square?哪个数是完全平方数？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根 (Grade年级 8–10)
Know the squares 1,4,9,…,225. ab​=a​b​, so 50​=25​2​=52​. But a+b​=a​+b​: 9+16​=5, not 7. x​ means the non-negative root.记住 1,4,9,…,225 这些平方数。ab​=a​b​，所以 50​=25​2​=52​。但 a+b​=a​+b​：9+16​=5，不是 7。x​ 表示非负的那个根。
  1. 72​: biggest square factor is 36 → 62​.72​：最大的平方因数是 36 → 62​。
  2. x2=49 has TWO answers x=±7, but 49​=7 only.x2=49 有两个解 x=±7，但 49​ 只等于 7。
Try one:试一道：
Which is equal to 48​?哪个等于 48​？

  1. 72​: biggest square factor is 36 → 62​.72​：最大的平方因数是 36 → 62​。
  2. x2=49 has TWO answers x=±7, but 49​=7 only.x2=49 有两个解 x=±7，但 49​ 只等于 7。

3Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方）
Write 72 as a product of prime numbers.把 72 写成质数的乘积。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方） (Grade年级 9)
Same base: multiply → ADD exponents (x3x4=x7); divide → SUBTRACT (x7÷x2=x5); power of a power → MULTIPLY ((x3)2=x6). A power of a product hits every factor: (2x)3=8x3.同底数：相乘→指数相加（x3x4=x7）；相除→指数相减（x7÷x2=x5）；幂的乘方→指数相乘（(x3)2=x6）。积的乘方每个因数都要乘方：(2x)3=8x3。
  1. (3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5.(3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5。
  2. 2x26x5​=3x3 (divide the numbers, subtract the exponents).2x26x5​=3x3（系数相除，指数相减）。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 4x(2x3)2​.化简 4x(2x3)2​。

4Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方）
Simplify x6​ for x≥0.当 x≥0 时，化简 x6​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方） (Grade年级 9)
Same base: multiply → ADD exponents (x3x4=x7); divide → SUBTRACT (x7÷x2=x5); power of a power → MULTIPLY ((x3)2=x6). A power of a product hits every factor: (2x)3=8x3.同底数：相乘→指数相加（x3x4=x7）；相除→指数相减（x7÷x2=x5）；幂的乘方→指数相乘（(x3)2=x6）。积的乘方每个因数都要乘方：(2x)3=8x3。
  1. (3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5.(3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5。
  2. 2x26x5​=3x3 (divide the numbers, subtract the exponents).2x26x5​=3x3（系数相除，指数相减）。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 4x(2x3)2​.化简 4x(2x3)2​。

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Simplify 398​.化简 398​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Square root, radicand 98, already a 3 outside.平方根，被开方数是 98，外面已经有一个 3。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    A number times  ​ of a number with no square factor.要写成「一个数乘以根号」，根号里没有平方因数。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Factor tree: 98=2⋅7⋅7. One pair of 7s, one 2 left over.因数树：98=2⋅7⋅7。有一对 7，剩一个 2。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    98=49⋅2, so 98​=49​⋅2​=72​.98=49⋅2，所以 98​=49​⋅2​=72​。
  5. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Multiply by the 3 already outside: 3⋅72​=212​.再乘上外面原有的 3：3⋅72​=212​。
  6. ✅ Check检验
    Multiply back: 212⋅2=882 and 32⋅98=882 ✓. The leftover 2 has no square factor.乘回去：212⋅2=882，32⋅98=882 ✓。剩下的 2 没有平方因数。
✔
212​
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Simplify 2180​.化简 2180​。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Square root, radicand 180, a 2 outside.平方根，被开方数是 180，外面有一个 2。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: find the LARGEST perfect square that divides 180.轮到你：找出能整除 180 的「最大」完全平方数。
    36, because 180=36⋅5 (and 5 has no square factor).36，因为 180=36⋅5（而 5 没有平方因数）。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: take its root out and multiply by the 2.轮到你：把它的平方根提出来，再乘以 2。
    180​=65​, so 2⋅65​=125​.180​=65​，所以 2⋅65​=125​。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    122⋅5=720 and 22⋅180=720 ✓.122⋅5=720，22⋅180=720 ✓。
Answer答案
125​
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Simplify 4288​.化简 4288​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Try the big squares first: does 144 divide 288?先试大的平方数：144 能整除 288 吗？
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    288=144⋅2, so 288​=122​. Do not forget the 4 outside.288=144⋅2，所以 288​=122​。别忘了外面的 4。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    Check: (your outside number)2×2 should equal 16⋅288=4608.检验：（你得到的外面的数）2×2 应等于 16⋅288=4608。
482​
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    288=144⋅2, so 288​=122​.288=144⋅2，所以 288​=122​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    4⋅122​=482​.4⋅122​=482​。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    482⋅2=4608=16⋅288 ✓. (If you used 4⋅72 first, keep going: 72​=62​ still simplifies.)482⋅2=4608=16⋅288 ✓。（如果你先拆成 4⋅72，就继续：72​=62​ 还能化简。）

Example 1例 1L1 Know知道2 methods种解法
Simplify (a) 72​ (b) 3−54​ (c) 548​.化简 (a) 72​ (b) 3−54​ (c) 548​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (a) 72=36⋅2, so 72​=62​.(a) 72=36⋅2，所以 72​=62​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (b) −54=−27⋅2 and 3−27​=−3, so −332​.(b) −54=−27⋅2，3−27​=−3，所以结果是 −332​。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (c) 48=16⋅3: 5⋅43​=203​.(c) 48=16⋅3：5⋅43​=203​。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    (a) 72=2⋅2⋅2⋅3⋅3. Each PAIR comes out as one number: a pair of 2s → 2, a pair of 3s → 3, one 2 stays. 2⋅32​=62​.(a) 72=2⋅2⋅2⋅3⋅3。每一对出来一个：一对 2 → 2，一对 3 → 3，剩一个 2 留在里面。2⋅32​=62​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Use this when you cannot spot the biggest square — it never misses one.找不到最大平方因数时就用这个方法，绝不会漏。
Answer答案
62​, −332​, 203​

💡 Key idea解题思路
Pull out the largest perfect power that divides the radicand.把被开方数中最大的完全方（或立方）因数提到根号外。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Largest perfect square (or cube) factor: 72=36⋅2.找最大的完全平方（立方）因数：72=36⋅2。
  • Prime factorization: pair up equal primes under the root.质因数分解：把根号下成对（成三）的质因数提出来。
Example 2例 2L2 Apply会做
Simplify 18x3y4​ and state the restriction on x.化简 18x3y4​，并写出 x 的限制条件。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    18x3y4=(9x2y4)(2x). 9x2y4​=3xy2.18x3y4=(9x2y4)(2x)，9x2y4​=3xy2。
  2. 🔎 Given已知
    Result 3xy22x​. The radicand 18x3y4≥0 needs x≥0 (y4 is never negative).结果是 3xy22x​。根号内 18x3y4≥0 要求 x≥0（y4 永远非负）。
Answer答案
3xy22x​, x≥0
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Simplify a radical with variables and state the restriction that keeps it real.化简含字母的根式，并说明使其有意义的限制条件。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理✍️ Communicating表达规范
💡 Key idea解题思路
Split numbers and each variable into a perfect-square part and a leftover; the leftover x forces x≥0.把数字和各字母拆成完全平方部分与剩余部分；剩下的 x 要求 x≥0。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Split into square factors: 9⋅x2⋅y4⋅2x.拆成平方因子：9⋅x2⋅y4⋅2x。
  • Rational exponents: (18x3y4)1/2, halve each exponent.用分数指数：(18x3y4)1/2，每个指数减半。
Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用2 methods种解法
Order from least to greatest without a calculator: 35​, 211​, 43​, 7, 3350​.不用计算器，从小到大排列：35​、211​、43​、7、3350​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Square roots: 35​=45​, 211​=44​, 43​=48​, 7=49​.平方根：35​=45​，211​=44​，43​=48​，7=49​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    So 211​<35​<43​<7.所以 211​<35​<43​<7。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    The cube root has a different index. Compare with 7 using cubes: 7=3343​, and 350>343, so 3350​>7.立方根的根指数不同，用立方和 7 比：7=3343​，而 350>343，所以 3350​>7。
  4. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Order: 211​, 35​, 43​, 7, 3350​.顺序：211​, 35​, 43​, 7, 3350​。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    5​≈2.236 so 35​≈6.71; 11​≈3.317 so 211​≈6.63; 3​≈1.732 so 43​≈6.93.5​≈2.236，35​≈6.71；11​≈3.317，211​≈6.63；3​≈1.732，43​≈6.93。
  2. ✅ Check检验
    Same order. But when values are this close, entire radicals are safer — an estimate can be off in the second decimal.顺序相同。但数值这么接近时，整根式更可靠——估算可能在第二位小数上出错。
Answer答案
211​<35​<43​<7<3350​

Put everything in the same form (all entire radicals, or all near known roots) before comparing.比较前先化成同一种形式（全部写成完整根式，或都和已知平方根比较）。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Convert each to an entire radical and compare radicands; for the cube root compare cubes.都化成完整根式比被开方数；含立方根的比较立方。
  • Estimate each with neighbouring perfect squares, e.g. 5​≈2.2, then multiply.用相邻完全平方数估值，如 5​≈2.2，再相乘。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Stopping before the largest square is out没提出最大的平方因数就停了
Simplify 200​.化简 200​。

🧠 The first square that came to mind was 4, and line 1 is true. But 50=25⋅2 still hides a square, so the answer is not finished.最先想到的平方数是 4，第 1 行本身没错。可 50=25⋅2 里还藏着平方数，所以还没化完。

🔧 Keep going: 250​=2⋅52​=102​. Faster: 200=100⋅2.继续：250​=2⋅52​=102​。更快的做法：200=100⋅2。

✔ 102​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 A

2Not squaring the outside number when moving it in把外面的数移进根号时没有平方
Write 53​ as an entire radical.把 53​ 写成整根式。

🧠 Moving in feels like "just put it under the root". But 5 is the root of 25, so it goes in as 25.感觉「移进去」就是直接放进根号。可是 5 是 25 的平方根，所以进去的是 25。

🔧 53​=25⋅3​=75​. Check: 15​≈3.9 but 53​≈8.7.53​=25⋅3​=75​。检验：15​≈3.9，而 53​≈8.7。

✔ 75​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 2

3Comparing only the outside numbers比较大小只看外面的数
Which is greater, 37​ or 217​?37​ 和 217​ 哪个大？

🧠 It looks like comparing coefficients of like terms. But the radicands are different, so the outside number alone tells you nothing.看起来像比较同类项的系数。可是被开方数不同，只看外面的数说明不了什么。

🔧 Move the outside numbers in: 37​=63​ and 217​=68​. Since 68>63, 217​ is greater.把外面的数移进去：37​=63​，217​=68​。因为 68>63，所以 217​ 更大。

✔ 217​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A

4Taking a whole odd power out of the root把奇次幂整个提出根号
Simplify 20x5​ and state the restriction.化简 20x5​，并写出限制条件。

🧠 The letter was treated as if it were already a square. A square root HALVES an exponent, and only an even power can come out: x5=x4⋅x.把字母当成已经是平方了。平方根会让指数「减半」，只有偶次幂才能整个出来：x5=x4⋅x。

🔧 20x5=(4x4)(5x), so 20x5​=2x25x​, with x≥0.20x5=(4x4)(5x)，所以 20x5​=2x25x​，且 x≥0。

✔ 2x25x​, x≥02x25x​，x≥0

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 4

5Splitting a root over a plus sign把根号对加法拆开
Simplify 36+64​.化简 36+64​。

🧠 The product rule ab​=a​b​ is real, so it is tempting to use the same move for +. There is no such rule for addition.乘法法则 ab​=a​b​ 是对的，于是很想对 + 也这样拆。加法没有这条法则。

🔧 Add first: 100​=10. (Check: 142=196=100.)先加：100​=10。（检验：142=196=100。）

✔ 10

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Not using the LARGEST square: 72​=218​ is not finished, since 18​=32​ still simplifies. Check the leftover radicand has no square factor.没用最大的平方因数：72​=218​ 还没化完，18​=32​ 还能化简。最后检查根号里不能再有平方因数。
  • Forgetting to square when moving in: 35​=45​, not 15​.挪进根号时忘了平方：35​=45​，不是 15​。
  • Splitting a sum: 9+16​=5, not 3+4. The product rule works for × only.把和拆开：9+16​=5，不是 3+4。乘法法则只对乘法成立。

💡 Why it works为什么成立

Simplifying Radicals Easy Method
Mario's Math Tutoring · 4 min · ↗
The shortest way in. The "pair of shoes" picture and the one-line check (square the outside, multiply by the inside, get the original number) work for a student who does not know their times tables well enough to spot perfect squares.最短的入门视频。「一双鞋」的比喻，加上一句话的验算（外面的数平方后乘里面的数，应该回到原来的数），对乘法口诀不熟、看不出完全平方数的同学很管用。
⏩ From 0:11 (about 4 minutes): a factor tree for 48​ (0:40), a pair of 2s and a pair of 2s leave one 3, so 43​; check by squaring the outside number, 42⋅3=48 (1:42). 1:53 72​=62​. 2:48 a cube root, 396​=2312​ (look for three of the same number).从 0:11 开始（约 4 分钟）：给 48​ 画因数树（0:40），两对 2 各出一个，剩下一个 3，得 43​；用「外面的数平方」验算，42⋅3=48（1:42）。1:53 72​=62​。2:48 立方根 396​=2312​（找三个相同的数）。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

WCLN - Simplifying radicals using prime factors
WCLN · 7 min · ↗
The prime-factor method never needs you to spot the biggest perfect square, so you cannot stop too early (a common lost mark). Doing a square root and a cube root with the same circling idea also shows what the index changes.质因数法不需要你自己找「最大的完全平方数」，所以不会化简到一半就停（这是常见的丢分点）。同一个圈法既做平方根又做立方根，也让你看清「根指数」改变了什么。
⏩ From 0:29 (about 8 minutes): prime-factor the radicand and circle matching groups: pairs for square roots, triples for cube roots. 0:29 72​=62​; 1:51 864​=126​; 3:25 3144​=2318​; 4:55 3648​=633​. 6:33 repeats the steps as a checklist.从 0:29 开始（约 8 分钟）：把被开方数分解成质因数，圈出相同的组：平方根圈「一对」，立方根圈「三个一组」。0:29 72​=62​；1:51 864​=126​；3:25 3144​=2318​；4:55 3648​=633​。6:33 把步骤整理成清单。

📝 Test-style problems考题实战

WCLN - Mixed Radicals to Entire Radicals
WCLN · 9 min · ↗
Our topic hook is exactly this: which is bigger without a calculator? Once everything is under one root you just compare the numbers inside, and that is the question type tests like to ask.我们这一节开头问的就是这个：不用计算器，哪个更大？全都放进同一个根号后，只要比较里面的数，考试正爱考这种题。
⏩ From 0:22 (about 8 minutes): the reverse move, writing a mixed radical as an entire radical by squaring (or cubing) the outside part and putting it under the root: 4x23x​=48x5​ (0:22), a fraction version (1:16), cube roots (2:33). 5:05 uses it to order 1010​, 913​, 815​: they become 1000​, 1053​, 960​.从 0:22 开始（约 8 分钟）：反过来做，把「带系数的根式」写成「全部在根号里」：把外面的部分平方（或立方）后放进根号，4x23x​=48x5​（0:22）；1:16 是分式版本；2:33 是立方根。5:05 用它给 1010​、913​、815​ 排大小：它们变成 1000​、1053​、960​。
3 Problems to Challenge You Simplifying Radicals
Brian McLogan · 7 min · ↗
These are the "teacher sneaks it onto the test" questions, so they show whether you understand radicals or only copied the steps. The decimal one is the case most students freeze on.这些就是「老师没细讲却会出在考卷上」的题，能看出你是真懂根式，还是只会照抄步骤。最后那道小数题尤其容易让人卡住。
⏩ From 0:45 (about 7 minutes, an extension, so do it after the basics): three tricky questions. 4a2+4a+1​=2a+1 because it is a perfect square trinomial, and he shows why 9+4​=9​+4​ (0:45–2:40; he does not mention the absolute value, so it assumes 2a+1≥0). 2:45 a root inside a root, working from the inside out. 4:45 40.0016​=0.2 by rewriting the decimal as a fraction.从 0:45 开始（约 7 分钟，属于拓展，基础会了再看）：三道有「陷阱」的题。4a2+4a+1​=2a+1，因为它是完全平方三项式，并说明 9+4​=9​+4​（0:45–2:40；他没提绝对值，相当于默认 2a+1≥0）。2:45 根号套根号，从里往外化。4:45 40.0016​=0.2，把小数写成分数来做。

Type each answer and press Check. A wrong answer is not a mark against you: it comes back tomorrow, then in 3 days, a week and two weeks.写下答案按「提交」。答错不扣分：它会明天再出现，然后是 3 天、一周、两周后。 Mixed practice from all topics →各知识点混合练习 →

1. Write 72​ in simplest form ab​.把 72​ 写成最简形式 ab​。
√
Right so far (218​=72​) but 18 still hides a perfect square (9). Use the biggest square factor.方向对（218​=72​），但 18 里还藏着完全平方数 9。要用最大的平方因数。
Right so far (38​=72​) but 8 still has the square factor 4. Keep going.方向对（38​=72​），但 8 里还有平方因数 4，继续化。
The 36 comes out of the root as its square root, 6, not as 36.36 出根号时要变成它的平方根 6，不是 36。

✔ 6 √ 2 62​

72=36⋅2 and 36​=6, so 72​=62​.72=36⋅2，36​=6，所以 72​=62​。

2. Write 50​ as ab​.把 50​ 写成 ab​。
√
25​ is 5, not 25.25​ 是 5，不是 25。

✔ 5 √ 2 52​

50=25⋅2, so 50​=52​.50=25⋅2，所以 50​=52​。

3. Write 35​ as an entire radical   ​.把 35​ 写成整根式   ​。
√
The 3 goes inside as 32=9, then 9⋅5=45; 3⋅5 is not the rule.3 要先平方成 32=9 再乘 5，得 45；不是 3⋅5。

✔ √ 45 45​

Square the 3 to move it inside: 35​=9⋅5​=45​.把 3 平方后放进根号：35​=9⋅5​=45​。

4. 50​ lies between which two consecutive whole numbers?50​ 在哪两个相邻的整数之间？
and
Those are half of 50. Square the whole numbers instead: 72=49, 82=64.那是 50 的一半。换个方向：把整数平方，72=49，82=64。

✔ 7 and 8

72=49<50<64=82, so 7<50​<8 (and a bit above 7: 52​≈7.07).72=49<50<64=82，所以 7<50​<8（略大于 7：52​≈7.07）。

5. Which is larger: 45​ or 43​?45​ 与 43​ 哪个更大？

✔ 43​

Put both under one root: 43​=16⋅3​=48​>45​.都放进根号里比较：43​=16⋅3​=48​>45​。

🗣️ Explain it back用自己的话讲一遍

Say how you simplify 72​ and how you know you are finished.说说你怎样化简 72​，以及怎么知道已经化到最简。

Pull out the biggest perfect square factor: 72=36⋅2, so 72​=62​. I am finished when the number under the root has no perfect-square factor left (2 has none).找出最大的完全平方因数：72=36⋅2，所以 72​=62​。根号里的数不再含有完全平方因数（2 没有）就说明化完了。

📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小The real number system实数系统
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力

💡 Key idea解题思路
Turn the bounds into entire radicals, then square all three parts.把两端化成完整根式，再对三部分同时平方。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Entire radicals: 12​<k​<18​.化成完整根式：12​<k​<18​。
  • Number line of k​ for k=10 to 20 using decimal estimates.用小数估值在数轴上排出 k=10 到 20 的 k​。

A square patio has area 180 m2. Write its side length as a simplified radical and to the nearest tenth.一个正方形露台面积为 180 m2。用最简根式表示边长，并精确到 0.1 m。
180=36⋅5.180=36⋅5。
65​≈13.4 m
  1. Side =180​=36⋅5​=65​≈13.4 m.边长 =180​=36⋅5​=65​≈13.4 m。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Find a side length from an area and give both exact and decimal forms.由面积求边长，写出精确值和小数值。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识

💡 Key idea解题思路
Side =area​; simplify with 180=36⋅5 and then round.边长 =面积​；用 180=36⋅5 化简后再取近似。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Simplify first, then approximate 5​.先化简，再近似 5​。
  • Estimate between 132=169 and 142=196 to check 13.4.用 132=169 与 142=196 夹逼，验证 13.4 合理。

8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略
A square patio has area 288 m2. An electrician has a 34 m cable and wants to run it along two adjacent sides of the patio. Is the cable long enough? Decide without a calculator and justify your answer; then say how much cable is left over, to the nearest centimetre.一个正方形露台面积为 288 m2。电工有一根 34 m 的电缆，要沿露台相邻的两条边铺设。电缆够长吗？不用计算器作出判断并说明理由；再算出剩余电缆长度，精确到厘米。
Side =288​. Compare 242​ and 34 by squaring both.边长 =288​。把 242​ 与 34 各自平方来比较。
Yes: two sides are 242​ m <34 m, leaving about 0.06 m (6 cm).够：两条边共 242​ m <34 m，剩余约 0.06 m（6 cm）。
  1. 288​=144⋅2​=122​, so two sides need 242​ m.288​=144⋅2​=122​，两条边共需 242​ m。
  2. Square both: (242​)2=1152 and 342=1156. Since 1152<1156, 242​<34.各自平方：(242​)2=1152，342=1156。因为 1152<1156，所以 242​<34。
  3. Leftover: 34−242​≈34−33.94=0.06 m, about 6 cm.剩余：34−242​≈34−33.94=0.06 m，约 6 cm。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Decide a real-world length question by comparing an exact radical with a whole number.通过比较精确根式与整数，判断实际的长度问题。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小The real number system实数系统
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🌍 Modelling建模🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略
💡 Key idea解题思路
Both numbers are positive, so comparing their squares gives the same order.两个数都是正数，比较平方得到的大小顺序相同。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Square both sides and compare 1152 with 1156.两边平方，比较 1152 与 1156。
  • Estimate 2​≈1.414: 24×1.414≈33.94, then compare with 34 (tight, so the exact comparison is the safer proof).估值 2​≈1.414：24×1.414≈33.94，再与 34 比较（差距很小，所以平方比较才是可靠的证明）。
